basic_info.description: 745 Fillmore Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a classic Marina Style multifamily asset in the highly desirable Alamo Square neighborhood. Under the same ownership since 1979, this 17-unit building offers immediate upside through lease-up, renovation, and potential unit conversion. With four units delivered vacant and strong rental demand in the area, investors can capitalize on both short-term gains and long-term appreciation.      Alamo Square is one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods, known for its historic architecture, walkability, and proximity to cultural and commercial hubs. The property is surrounded by boutique retail, cafes, and major employment centers, making it a top choice for renters seeking charm and convenience.
